description: Surface de potentiel éolien par EPCI is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by TEO. La réglementation limite l’installation des éoliennes dans de nombreuses zones. Ainsi, le potentiel de développement de l’éolien dépend de nombreux facteurs dont la surface de zones qui ne sont pas réglementairement interdites. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are TEO, Ressources, Eolien terrestre, Energie-Climat, pays de la loire. The portal shows 72 records. The portal shows 2025-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
